mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept where parent_id = 0 and dept_name = '校学生会' and del_flag = '0' order by dept_id limit 1

select d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.status, (select count(*) from oa_member m where m.dept_id = d.dept_id and m.status = '0') as member_count from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.parent_id = (select dept_id from sys_dept where parent_id = 0 and dept_name = '校学生会' and del_flag = '0' order by dept_id limit 1) order by d.order_num, d.dept_id

select d.dept_id, d.dept_name from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.parent_id = (select dept_id from sys_dept where parent_id = 0 and dept_name = '校学生会' and del_flag = '0' order by dept_id limit 1) order by d.order_num, d.dept_id
mapper.update: update sys_dept set leader = #{leader} where dept_id = #{deptId}
